sentences.en: No thanks, I have my own bag.
sentences.pt: Não, obrigado, tenho o meu saco.

sentences.en: Do you have a loyalty card?

passages.text: Son veintitrés con cuarenta. ¿Tiene tarjeta de cliente? Con ella hoy tiene un diez por ciento de descuento en la fruta. Las bolsas cuestan diez céntimos cada una.
passages.en: That's twenty-three forty. Do you have a loyalty card? With it you get ten percent off fruit today. Bags cost ten cents each.
passages.question: Which statement is true?
passages.answer: With a loyalty card, fruit is ten percent cheaper today.
wrong: The total is thirty-two euros forty.
Everything is ten percent off, card or not.
